compose:
services:
  big-bear-seafile-v14:
    container_name: big-bear-seafile-v14
    image: seafileltd/seafile-mc:14.0.9@sha256:75d8b88e8bfaa54099082aec0e99ff1a962bd364bfc21da34125fa66998f0861
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      big-bear-seafile-v14-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      big-bear-seafile-v14-redis:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/shared:/shared
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_HOST=big-bear-seafile-v14-db
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_PORT=3306
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_USER=seafile
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_PASSWORD=${SECRET_SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_PASSWORD}
      - INIT_SEAFILE_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_INIT_SEAFILE_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_CCNET_DB_NAME=ccnet_db
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_SEAFILE_DB_NAME=seafile_db
      - SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_SEAHUB_DB_NAME=seahub_db
      - TIME_ZONE=Etc/UTC
      - INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com
      - INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET_INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - SEAFILE_SERVER_HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1:8146
      - SEAFILE_SERVER_PROTOCOL=http
      - JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${SECRET_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - ENABLE_SEADOC=false
      - CACHE_PROVIDER=redis
      - REDIS_HOST=big-bear-seafile-v14-redis
      - REDIS_PORT=6379
      - REDIS_PASSWORD=${SECRET_REDIS_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:80 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    networks:
      - big-bear-seafile-v14-network
  big-bear-seafile-v14-db:
    container_name: big-bear-seafile-v14-db
    image: mariadb:10.11@sha256:be981e4113326ada8d6004174dd09eeaefc03094037f811182a52d4f2e737350
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_INIT_SEAFILE_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_LOG_CONSOLE=true
      - MARIADB_AUTO_UPGRADE=1
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "healthcheck.sh", "--connect", "--mariadbupgrade", "--innodb_initialized"]
      start_period: 1m
      start_interval: 10s
      interval: 1m
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    networks:
      - big-bear-seafile-v14-network
  big-bear-seafile-v14-redis:
    container_name: big-bear-seafile-v14-redis
    image: redis:8.2.2-alpine@sha256:1c78f5e7512cc8b22b0edc95c20e7abd9e1fd832e5dfd5c3c6b59ce82fb238d0
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass "$$REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no
    environment:
      - REDIS_PASSWORD=${SECRET_REDIS_PASSWORD}
    networks:
      - big-bear-seafile-v14-network
networks:
  big-bear-seafile-v14-network:
    driver: bridge
